UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores user-specific application data, linked to an external authentication system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

profileImageUrl.description: URL to the user's profile picture.

selectedBoardIds.description: References to Boards the user is interested in. (Relationship: Board N:N UserProfile)

selectedExamTypeIds.description: References to ExamTypes the user is interested in. (Relationship: ExamType N:N UserProfile)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

Board.title: Board
Board.description: Represents an educational board, such as CBSE or NIOS.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Board entity.

name.description: The official name of the board (e.g., 'CBSE', 'NIOS').

description.description: A brief description of the board.

ExamType.title: ExamType
ExamType.description: Represents a type of competitive government exam, such as SSC, RRB, or Delhi Police.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ExamType entity.

name.description: The official name or abbreviation of the exam type (e.g., 'SSC', 'RRB', 'Delhi Police').

description.description: A brief description of the exam type.

Subject.title: Subject
Subject.description: Represents an academic subject (e.g., Mathematics, Science, General Awareness).

id.description: Unique identifier for the Subject entity.

description.description: A brief description of the subject.

Course.title: Course
Course.description: Represents a structured learning path, such as 'CBSE Class 10 Math' or 'SSC CGL General Awareness'.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Course entity.

description.description: A detailed description of the course content and objectives.

subjectId.description: Reference to the primary Subject this course belongs to. (Relationship: Subject 1:N Course)

boardId.description: Optional reference to the Board for academic courses. (Relationship: Board 1:N Course)

examTypeId.description: Optional reference to the ExamType for competitive exam preparation courses. (Relationship: ExamType 1:N Course)

academicYear.description: Optional academic year for school-level courses (e.g., 4 for Class 4, 12 for Class 12).

isPublished.description: Indicates if the course is publicly visible and available to users.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the course was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the course was last updated.

Module.title: Module
Module.description: A subdivision of a course, containing related content items and topics.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Module entity.

title.description: The title of the module (e.g., 'Algebra', 'Indian History').

description.description: A brief description of the module's content.

courseId.description: Reference to the Course this module belongs to. (Relationship: Course 1:N Module)

order.description: The display order of the module within its course.

isPublished.description: Indicates if the module is publicly visible and available to users.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the module was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the module was last updated.

ContentItem.title: ContentItem
ContentItem.description: An individual piece of learning material such as a video, text lesson, or document.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ContentItem entity.

title.description: The title of the content item.

description.description: A brief description of the content item.

moduleId.description: Reference to the Module this content item belongs to. (Relationship: Module 1:N ContentItem)

url.description: Optional URL for external content like videos or PDFs.

textContent.description: Optional inline text content for text-based lessons.

estimatedDurationMinutes.description: The estimated duration of the content item in minutes.

difficultyLevel.description: The perceived difficulty level of the content item (e.g., 'beginner', 'intermediate', 'advanced').

order.description: The display order of the content item within its module.

isPublished.description: Indicates if the content item is publicly visible and available to users.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the content item was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the content item was last updated.

Question.title: Question
Question.description: Represents a single question used in quizzes or practice tests.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Question entity.

explanation.description: An explanation or solution for the question.

subjectId.description: Reference to the Subject this question belongs to. (Relationship: Subject 1:N Question)

difficultyLevel.description: The difficulty level of the question (e.g., 'easy', 'medium', 'hard').

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the question was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the question was last updated.

AnswerOption.title: AnswerOption
AnswerOption.description: Represents an option for a multiple-choice or true/false question.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AnswerOption entity.

questionId.description: Reference to the Question this answer option belongs to. (Relationship: Question 1:N AnswerOption)

optionText.description: The text content of the answer option.

isCorrect.description: Indicates if this option is the correct answer.

order.description: The display order of the option within the question.

PracticeTest.title: PracticeTest
PracticeTest.description: A collection of questions forming a practice test or quiz.

id.description: Unique identifier for the PracticeTest entity.

title.description: The title of the practice test.

description.description: A brief description of the practice test.

courseId.description: Reference to the Course this practice test is associated with. (Relationship: Course 1:N PracticeTest)

moduleId.description: Optional reference to the Module this practice test is specifically for. (Relationship: Module 1:N PracticeTest)

durationMinutes.description: The recommended duration for completing the test in minutes.

passScorePercentage.description: The minimum percentage score required to pass the test.

questionIds.description: References to Questions included in this practice test. (Relationship: Question N:N PracticeTest)

isPublished.description: Indicates if the practice test is publicly visible and available to users.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the practice test was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the practice test was last updated.

StudyPlan.title: StudyPlan
StudyPlan.description: A personalized study plan generated for a user, potentially by AI.

id.description: Unique identifier for the StudyPlan entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile this study plan belongs to. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N StudyPlan)

title.description: The title of the study plan (e.g., 'My Class 10 Math Prep Plan').

description.description: A brief description or summary of the study plan.

startDate.description: The planned start date for the study plan.

endDate.description: The planned end date for the study plan.

status.description: The current status of the study plan (e.g., 'active', 'completed', 'archived').

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the study plan was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the study plan was last updated.

StudyPlanTask.title: StudyPlanTask
StudyPlanTask.description: An individual task or activity within a user's study plan.

id.description: Unique identifier for the StudyPlanTask entity.

studyPlanId.description: Reference to the StudyPlan this task belongs to. (Relationship: StudyPlan 1:N StudyPlanTask)

title.description: The title of the study task (e.g., 'Complete Algebra Basics Video').

description.description: A brief description of the task.

contentItemId.description: Optional reference to a ContentItem if the task involves content consumption. (Relationship: ContentItem 1:N StudyPlanTask)

practiceTestId.description: Optional reference to a PracticeTest if the task involves taking a test. (Relationship: PracticeTest 1:N StudyPlanTask)

dueDate.description: The date by which the task is expected to be completed.

status.description: The current status of the task (e.g., 'pending', 'in_progress', 'completed', 'skipped').

notes.description: Optional user-added notes for the task.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the study plan task was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the study plan task was last updated.

UserCourseProgress.title: UserCourseProgress
UserCourseProgress.description: Tracks a user's overall progress within a specific course.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserCourseProgress entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N UserCourseProgress)

courseId.description: Reference to the Course being tracked. (Relationship: Course 1:N UserCourseProgress)

status.description: The overall status of the user's progress in the course (e.g., 'not_started', 'in_progress', 'completed').

progressPercentage.description: The percentage of the course completed (0-100).

lastAccessedAt.description: Timestamp of the last time the user accessed content in this course.

completedAt.description: Optional timestamp when the user completed the course.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the progress record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the progress record was last updated.

UserContentProgress.title: UserContentProgress
UserContentProgress.description: Tracks a user's progress on an individual content item.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserContentProgress entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N UserContentProgress)

contentItemId.description: Reference to the ContentItem being tracked. (Relationship: ContentItem 1:N UserContentProgress)

status.description: The status of the user's interaction with the content item (e.g., 'not_started', 'started', 'completed').

lastAccessedAt.description: Timestamp of the last time the user accessed this content item.

completedAt.description: Optional timestamp when the user completed this content item.

timeSpentSeconds.description: The total time (in seconds) the user has spent on this content item.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the progress record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the progress record was last updated.

UserTestAttempt.title: UserTestAttempt
UserTestAttempt.description: Records a user's attempt at a specific practice test.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserTestAttempt entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N UserTestAttempt)

practiceTestId.description: Reference to the PracticeTest attempted. (Relationship: PracticeTest 1:N UserTestAttempt)

attemptNumber.description: The sequential number of this attempt for the given test by the user.

score.description: The score obtained by the user in this attempt.

maxScore.description: The maximum possible score for the practice test.

timeTakenMinutes.description: The time taken by the user to complete the test in minutes.

submittedAt.description: Timestamp when the test attempt was submitted.

passed.description: Indicates if the user passed the test based on the passScorePercentage.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the test attempt record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the test attempt record was last updated.

UserAnswer.title: UserAnswer
UserAnswer.description: Stores a user's specific answer(s) to a question within a test attempt.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserAnswer entity.

userTestAttemptId.description: Reference to the UserTestAttempt this answer belongs to. (Relationship: UserTestAttempt 1:N UserAnswer)

questionId.description: Reference to the Question answered. (Relationship: Question 1:N UserAnswer)

selectedOptionIds.description: References to AnswerOptions selected by the user (for multiple-choice questions). (Relationship: AnswerOption N:N UserAnswer)

responseText.description: Optional text response from the user (for fill-in-the-blank or open-ended questions).

isCorrect.description: Indicates if the user's answer(s) to the question were correct.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user's answer was recorded.

firestore.reasoning:
The proposed Firestore data structure is designed to be secure, scalable, and highly debuggable, strictly adhering to the core design principles and strategy mandates. 

**Authorization Independence (CRITICAL):**
This design prioritizes authorization independence by carefully segmenting data and denormalizing authorization context where necessary. 

1.  **User-Owned Data:** All user-specific data (UserProfile, StudyPlans, Progress, Test Attempts, User Answers) is placed under the `/users/{userId}` root. This employs a robust path-based ownership model (`/users/{userId}/studyPlans/{studyPlanId}`). Authorization rules can directly check `request.auth.uid == userId` at any level of this hierarchy (e.g., `match /users/{userId}/studyPlans/{studyPlanId}/tasks/{studyPlanTaskId}`), ensuring that a user can only access their own data. This eliminates the need for `get()` calls to parent documents to determine ownership, thus supporting atomic operations and greatly simplifying rule debugging.

2.  **Public Content:** For public content like `Boards`, `ExamTypes`, and `Subjects`, the collections are top-level (`/boards/{boardId}`). These are universally readable. For `Courses`, `Modules`, `ContentItems`, and `PracticeTests`, public read access is controlled by an `isPublished` boolean field within each document. This field acts as a denormalized authorization context for public visibility. Rules can check `resource.data.isPublished == true` without needing to fetch any parent document, making authorization atomic and independent.

3.  **Admin Access:** Administrative roles are managed via a dedicated `roles_admin/{adminUid}` collection (not explicitly listed in `firestorePaths` as it's a conceptual access control layer, but implied for DBAC). An admin's UID existing in this collection grants them elevated privileges across various collections, independent of specific document attributes.

**QAPs (Rules are not Filters):**
This structure strongly supports Query-As-Permissions (QAPs) by ensuring that security rules enforce what a user *can* access, rather than relying on client-side filtering or complex server-side rule filtering that could expose unauthorized data.

1.  **User-Owned Data:** For `/users/{userId}/...` collections, a user can only query (list) their own subcollections. This naturally aligns with QAPs, as any `list` operation will be implicitly scoped to the authenticated user's ID, preventing unauthorized access.

2.  **Public Content:** For `Courses`, `Modules`, `ContentItems`, and `PracticeTests`, public `list` operations are secured by requiring a query filter like `where('isPublished', '==', true)`. The security rules will enforce this, rejecting any `list` query that doesn't include the necessary `isPublished` filter or that attempts to read unpublished data. This prevents unauthorized access to draft or private content while still enabling efficient public listing.

**Structural Segregation & Access Modeling:**
Collections are designed with a homogeneous security posture. For instance, all `UserProfile` documents in `/users/{userId}` have the same core `userId` ownership. `Boards` are all globally readable. This avoids mixing public and private data in the same collection, simplifying security rules significantly.

**Data Clarity and Predictability:**
Standardized naming conventions (e.g., `{userId}`, `{courseId}`) and explicit state modeling (`isPublished`, `status`) contribute to predictable schemas and easy-to-understand rules.
